### GET /api/v1/posts/scheduled-times

Upcoming scheduled times per connected account

Every future `scheduled_at` in the workspace, one row per account, nearest first. Thread roots only — sibling items in a thread chain off the root rather than holding a slot of their own. Plain drafts park a far-future sentinel `scheduled_at` and so fall outside the horizon; a rejected draft that still carries a real date is reported, matching what the calendar shows as occupying its slot. Used to skip slots that already hold a post when picking the next one.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |

**Responses**

- `200` — Upcoming scheduled times, nearest first
  - `ScheduledPostTimeList`
    - `items`: array of `ScheduledPostTime`, required
      - `accountId`: string, required
      - `scheduledAt`: string, required — ISO 8601 instant the post is due to fire.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### GET /api/v1/posts/search

Search posts by title or content

Case-insensitive substring match against the post text (any thread position) and its composer group's title, scoped to the organization. LIKE metacharacters in the query match literally. Powers the command menu's post search. Returns at most 20 composer groups, newest first.

**Auth:** API key or session
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |
| `q` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — Matching posts, newest first
  - `SearchPostsResult`
    - `items`: array of `SearchPostItem`, required
      - `id`: string, required — Composer group id, or the post id for an ungrouped post — matches the `?open=` deep link param.
      - `title`: string | null, required
      - `text`: string, required
      - `status`: one of `"draft"` | `"pending_approval"` | `"scheduled"` | `"publishing"` | `"published"`, required
      - `approvalStatus`: string | null, required — The post's own publish gate. A non-blocking review never writes it, so do NOT derive display state from this — use `bucket`.
      - `bucket`: one of `"drafts"` | `"needs_approval"` | `"needs_revision"` | `"approved"` | `"scheduled"` | `"posted"`, required — Which board column this post belongs in, derived from its *display* approval status — the same rule the planner and schedule board use (@orbitwrite/core/post-buckets). Approval state outranks the lifecycle status, so a scheduled post awaiting approval reads `needs_approval` rather than `scheduled`.
      - `lastError`: string | null, required — Most recent worker error for the matched row, when it hasn't yet succeeded. Lets result rows render the same has-issues state as the schedule.

### POST /api/v1/posts/delete-published

Delete a published group from the networks

Removes a published post (or a single thread row via `postId`) from Orbit. For each account id in `deleteFromAccountIds` it also deletes that account's live post from its platform via the platform API first — partial failures keep those rows so the delete can be retried. Accounts left out (or an empty list) are removed from Orbit only; their live posts stay up. Failed-to-publish siblings are dropped with the group since nothing exists remotely.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `DeletePublishedBody`
  - `groupId`: string, required
  - `postId`: string
  - `deleteFromAccountIds`: array of string

**Responses**

- `200` — Delete attempted on every published row; check `failures` for per-account errors
  - `DeletePublishedResult`
    - `ok`: boolean, required — True only when every network delete succeeded
    - `groupId`: string, required
    - `deleted`: integer, required
    - `failures`: array of `DeletePublishedFailure`, required
      - `postId`: string, required
      - `accountId`: string, required
      - `platform`: string | null, required
      - `reason`: string, required

### POST /api/v1/posts/unschedule

### POST /api/v1/posts/retry-publish

Retry publishing a single failed account in a composer group

Resets one account's failed unit (its draft-with-error / failed rows, plus any un-posted thread siblings) back to scheduled=now and re-fires the detached inline publish. ### POST /api/v1/posts/split-account

Split one failed account out of a shared composer group

Moves a single failed account's rows into their own composer group (converting the failed unit back to an editable draft) so it can be rescheduled on its own. ### GET /api/v1/posts

List a workspace's posts

Every post in the workspace — drafts, awaiting approval, scheduled and published — one entry per composer group, so a post synced to eight channels is one row carrying eight accounts. Cursor-paged rather than offset-paged: a workspace gains posts at the head, so an offset would re-show rows while a client pages. Filters combine with AND; repeat a parameter for OR within it. For one post's full content — threads, per-channel bodies, media, engagement — read it back with `GET /posts/draft?groupId=`.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |
| `limit` | integer (min 1, max 100, default 50) | no |  |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page. |
| `sort` | one of `"createdAt"` | `"scheduledAt"` (default "createdAt") | no | Order by the group's creation time (default) or its earliest fire time. Drafts have no fire time and sort as if scheduled indefinitely far out. |
| `direction` | one of `"asc"` | `"desc"` (default "desc") | no | Newest/latest first by default. |
| `status` | one of (one of `"draft"` | `"pending_approval"` | `"scheduled"` | `"publishing"` | `"published"` | array of one of `"draft"` | `"pending_approval"` | `"scheduled"` | `"publishing"` | `"published"`) | no | Lifecycle status. Repeat for OR (e.g. `?status=draft&status=scheduled`). |
| `bucket` | one of (one of `"drafts"` | `"needs_approval"` | `"needs_revision"` | `"approved"` | `"scheduled"` | `"posted"` | array of one of `"drafts"` | `"needs_approval"` | `"needs_revision"` | `"approved"` | `"scheduled"` | `"posted"`) | no | Board column. Approval state outranks the lifecycle status, so a scheduled post awaiting review is `needs_approval`, not `scheduled`. Repeat for OR. |
| `platform` | one of (string | array of string) | no | Platform id as returned by `/connected-accounts` (e.g. `twitter`, `linkedin_personal`). Matches a post going out on ANY of its channels. Repeat for OR. |
| `accountId` | one of (string | array of string) | no | Connected-account id. Matches a post going out on ANY of its channels. Repeat for OR. |
| `campaignId` | string | no |  |
| `scheduledAfter` | string | no | ISO 8601, inclusive, against the group's earliest fire time. Drafts have no fire time and are excluded by either bound. |
| `scheduledBefore` | string | no | ISO 8601, inclusive. |

**Responses**

- `200` — A page of posts
  - `PostList`
    - `entries`: array of `PostListEntry`, required
      - `id`: string, required — The composer group's id — what every group-addressed route (`/posts/draft`, `/posts/reschedule`, `/posts/discard`) takes.
      - `postId`: string, required — The representative row's own post id, for the post-addressed routes (`/posts/{postId}/analytics`).
      - `title`: string | null, required
      - `text`: string, required — The representative row's body. Per-channel bodies can differ; `GET /posts/draft?groupId=` returns them all, with threads and media.
      - `status`: one of `"draft"` | `"pending_approval"` | `"scheduled"` | `"publishing"` | `"published"`, required
      - `approvalStatus`: one of `"not_required"` | `"pending"` | `"approved"` | `"rejected"`, required — What the post READS as — its active approval request's status whether or not that request blocks. `bucket` is derived from this.
      - `approvalGateStatus`: one of `"not_required"` | `"pending"` | `"approved"` | `"rejected"`, required — The post's own approval column: the publish gate, which a non-blocking review never writes. Ask this when the question is 'would this publish?'.
      - `bucket`: one of `"drafts"` | `"needs_approval"` | `"needs_revision"` | `"approved"` | `"scheduled"` | `"posted"`, required — Which board column the post sits in.
      - `scheduledAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601 — the group's earliest fire time. Null for a draft that has never been given one.
      - `publishedAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601.
      - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
      - `updatedAt`: string, required — ISO 8601.
      - `hasThread`: boolean, required
      - `mediaCount`: integer, required
      - `lastError`: string | null, required — Most recent worker error, suppressed once the post published (a retry that eventually succeeded leaves its error behind).
      - `campaign`: object | null, required — The campaign this post belongs to, if any.
        - `id`: string, required
        - `title`: string | null, required
        - `color`: string | null, required
      - `tags`: array of object, required
        - `name`: string, required
        - `color`: string, required
      - `accounts`: array of `PostListAccount`, required — Every channel this post goes out on.
        - `id`: string, required
        - `platform`: string, required
        - `handle`: string | null, required
        - `displayName`: string | null, required
        - `avatarUrl`: string | null, required
    - `nextCursor`: string | null, required — Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. A cursor is tied to the `sort`/`direction` it was cut for — change either and start again without it.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/posts

Create scheduled posts (or publish immediately)

The composer's schedule/publish submit, and the way an integration creates posts. Validates platform capabilities, quote/reply targets, media URL safety, and engagement accounts; splits accounts into composer groups (synced accounts share one, each unsynced account gets its own); optionally replaces an existing group (re-schedule) or attaches a reviewer approval to each new group. With `publishNow` the adapter publish runs detached after the rows commit.

Media can be attached inline via an item's `media` (`{url, mimeType, …}`), or by id via `mediaIds` for files uploaded through `/media/create-upload-url`. Ids are resolved server-side and appended to that item's `media`; both forms can be used together, and up to 10 ids are accepted per item.

Authenticates with a workspace API key or a session cookie. The accounts posted to must all belong to the key's workspace; the posts are attributed to the user who created the key.

### GET /api/v1/posts/draft

Load a draft / scheduled / published group for the composer

Loads the whole composer state for a group (accounts, threads, media, engagement, Info-panel metadata) — the full-content read-back for a post. Also performs on-open recovery: an all-failed group converts back to an editable draft, and a scheduled group stuck long past its fire time (worker down, attempts exhausted) does too.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

    - `status`: one of `"draft"` | `"scheduled"` | `"pending_approval"` | `"published"` | `"failed"` | `"mixed"`, required — `failed` is only returned to a caller holding post:read but not post:update — the on-open recovery that would convert a failed group into an editable draft is a write, so it is skipped and the real state reported. Every workspace role holds post:update, so the app never sees it.
    - `scheduledAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601; null for plain drafts (their stored fire time is a far-future sentinel) and mixed groups.

### POST /api/v1/posts/draft

The composer's autosave, and the way an integration creates or edits an unscheduled draft. Replace-on-save: with `groupId` every editable row in the group is deleted and re-inserted, preserving the group's status (a scheduled group stays scheduled), per-account fire times, createdAt, and approval gate. ### GET /api/v1/posts/{groupId}/approval-request

Get a composer group's approval request

Returns the live reviewer-based approval request on the group (or null). Self-heals: a post held for approval with no request gets one with its author as sole reviewer, so older campaign posts render the same as manually-requested ones.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `groupId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The group's approval request, or null when there is none
  - `ApprovalRequestResult`
    - `request`: `ApprovalRequestSummary`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `status`: one of `"pending"` | `"approved"` | `"rejected"`, required
      - `requireAll`: boolean, required
      - `blocking`: boolean, required
      - `publishOnApprove`: boolean, required — The author asked for this to go out the moment it's approved, rather than at its scheduled time.
      - `message`: string | null, required
      - `dueDate`: string | null, required — ISO 8601.
      - `createdBy`: string, required
      - `reviewerCount`: integer, required
      - `approvedCount`: integer, required
      - `rejectedCount`: integer, required
      - `reviewers`: array of `ApprovalReviewerSummary`, required
        - `id`: string, required
        - `userId`: string, required
        - `name`: string, required
        - `image`: string | null, required
        - `decision`: one of `"approved"` | `"rejected"` | `null`, required — null → the reviewer hasn't decided yet.
      - `viewerIsReviewer`: boolean, required
      - `viewerDecision`: one of `"approved"` | `"rejected"` | `null` — Absent → the viewer isn't a reviewer; null → they haven't decided.
      - `viewerCanManage`: boolean, required
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/posts/{groupId}/approval-request

One intent-dispatched endpoint for the Info panel's approval row: create/edit the request (reviewer roster, message, due date, require-all, blocking), delete it, resend a reviewer's email, remove a reviewer, override a reviewer's decision, or reset all decisions. A missing intent defaults to create.

  - `Error`
- `409` — Conflicts with an existing resource
  - `Error`
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded
  - `Error`
